_about: MAIN RUN. The free predictions: the 80 sets where several sources demand the same option, each scenario once per size. 3,240 trials. Never fitted; scored against the pair fit of main-ladder-gpt-oss-20b-think with `scripts/strengths.sh main-ladder-gpt-oss-20b-think --free results/main-free-gpt-oss-20b-think/records.jsonl`.

gpt-oss-20b on sm80-vllm0280, thinking on (study-think-gpt-oss). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-free-gpt-oss-20b-think, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh gpt-oss-20b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
